6795: 19 year old student who's just found out he's failed his exam for the second time to get into college. He's currently lives in Tokyo with no close friends and he's down in the dumps, until he bumps into Musubi.
7318: The heroine. Minato's first Sekirei. She met Minato when she fell out of the sky. She is a power-Strength-type Sekirei. After hearing Tsukiumi say that she is Minato's wife she decides that she is gonna be his wife too.
7319: She is Minato's fourth Sekirei and her power is water (derived from her name "umi" which means the sea). She contacted him over a dream saying that she would kill him, but when they finally met she was persuaded into becoming his Sekirei. ( ch.
7320: The landlady of the Izumo Inn who is also known as the "Hannya of the North". Due to her fearsome reputation, no Ashikabi or Sekirei have dared to attack Izumo Inn.
7322: A Sekirei originally living at Izumo Inn when Minato and Musubi first arrived. Uzume's Ashikabi is a young girl named Chiho, who is confined to a hospital due to an unknown illness. Uzume had a large collection of costumes at the Inn, which she used to wear to entertain Chiho.
7323: She is often called Kuu-chan but was referred to as the "Green Girl". She is Minato's second Sekirei. She calls him Onii-chan (Japanese term for 'Older brother'). She has power over plants-to make them grow.
10052: A computer genius and hacker that lives in a secret room of Izumo Inn, and was once mistaken for a ghost by Kusano. She becomes Minato's third Sekirei. She also likes to shorten people's names and substitute tan for san.
12766: Akitsu, is a 'disused' Sekirei; Homura refers to her as 'Scrap Number'. She can't be winged by an Ashikabi or use the Norito (she is useless from MBI point of view).
12767: Yukari is Minato's sister. She has an affinity for strong bishounen types that resemble her older brother.
12768: Hiroto Minaka is the eccentric chairman and founder of MBI, with his motto being: "Fight and Fight Until One is Left". He, along with Takami, discovered the Sekirei and because of this, he feels that this entitles him to be the "Game Master" of the Sekirei Plan.
12769: Yukari's Sekirei who is searching for Kusano, whom he has a very close, sibling-like relationship with despite the fact that his power is the natural opposite of hers.
12770: Yomi is the first Sekirei that Musubi defeats. She wields a Death Scythe and uses wind element.
12771: Takami Sahashi is the mother of Minato and Yukari and the MBI's head researcher and person in charge of Sekirei Plan. She revealed that she lied about working at a pharmaceutical company to Minato after the escape plan when she took him in temporary custody.
12773: Haihane is a member of the Disciplinary Squad. She wears a tattered kimono over her bandaged body, has dishevelled grey hair and narrow eyes giving her a slightly Grim Reaper-like appearance.Even though she has dark or gothic appearance, it does not reflect her personality.
12774: Yume was formerly the founder of the Disciplinary Squad. When Musubi critically attacked by Benitsubasa, Yume came out and quickly disposed of her only to leave Musubi after the battle was over. She proclaimed she was the Defender of Love.
12775: Benitsubasa is also known as the 'Crimson (Red) Sekirei', she is a 'third generation' member of the MBI Disciplinary Squad. She is a hand-to-hand fighter, similar to Musubi, with a habit of sticking her tongue out while fighting.
12776: Kuno is often referred to as a klutz. Together with her Ashikabi and Minato's group she tries to escape the MBI controlled city. Her ability is song.
12777: Seo is a rough character that gets dominated by his two Sekirei Hikari and Hibiki. He usually takes on odd jobs around the city just to survive, and is helpful at times even if his rough exterior doesn't show it.
12986: Minato's sixth Sekirei. At first he was the self-proclaimed 'Sekirei guardian', he often interrupted Hikari and Hibiki's fights to side with the unwinged Sekirei.
13034: This is Seo's Sekirei and twin sister of Hibiki. She and her sister are Lightning elemental types. They try to attack un-winged Ayakashi to get an advantage over them.
13035: This is Seo's Ayakashi and twin sister of Hikari. She and her sister are Lightning elemental types. They try to attack unwinged Ayakashi to get an advantage over them.
14093: An Ashikabi. He currently reigns over the southern part of the city.
20416: One of the few male Sekirei seen other than Shiina. He is was once an 'S Plan Guardian', one of the five members of the 'first generation' Disciplinary Squad. Mutsu carries a sword with him but has never drawn it. His ashikabi (patner) is Hayato.
26313: She was assigned along with Akitsu to capture 'unwinged' Sekirei. She attempted to capture Shiina at one point but was blocked by Homura. Mitsuha hates people like Homura for being "lions of protection". She fights using a whip that is strong enough to break apart concrete.
34377: Haruka is the Ashikabi of Kuno. He can't stand seeing girls cry.
34432: The Ashikabi of all three members of the current, third generation Disciplinary Squad.
37883: Is a young girl who is confined into the Hiyamakai Hospital, owned by Higa Izumi, because she suffers from an aggressive, incurable virus. At the moment, the medicine she takes are just slowing down the spreading of the virus but the medicine doesn't heal her.
45871: Kakizaki is a bespectacled man who serves as Higa's "secretary" and is also an Ashikabi.
